1. // Copyright(c) The Maintainers of Nanvix.
2. // Licensed under the MIT License.
3. 
4. // PageAligned<T> — Specifications
5. //
6. // `PageAligned<T>` is a validated newtype wrapping a memory address (`int`)
7. // carrying the static guarantee that the address lies on a page boundary. Its
8. // abstract value is exactly that address (`PageAligned@ : int`, defined by the
9. // `View` impl in `page.rs`); the page-alignment fact is the property `inv()`
10. // over that value.
11. //
12. // `spec_addr` is the ghost projection of an arbitrary `T: Address` to its
13. // abstract address (`int`). It exists for *every* `T: Address` so that the
14. // `View` impl for `PageAligned<T>` — and hence the `@`-based contracts of the
15. // in-scope exec functions (`into_raw_value`, `from_address`) — can be stated
16. // for a bare `T: Address`, without the `T: View<V = int>` bound that would
17. //   * be unsatisfiable in a normal `cargo build` (the address-family `View`
18. //     impls are all `cfg(verus_keep_ghost)`-gated), and
19. //   * not be available on the generic exec `impl<T: Address> ...` blocks (and
20. //     would break `region.rs`, which uses `PageAligned<T>: Address` for a bare
21. //     `T: Address`).
22. // It is left uninterpreted here; the exec contracts pin it operationally
23. // (`into_raw_value` returns exactly `self@`), exactly as the sibling
24. // `FrameAddress::into_raw_value` trust boundary draws the same newtype-identity
25. // fact for the concrete frame address. It is `cfg(verus_keep_ghost)`-gated
26. // (ghost-only), so it does not exist in a normal build.
27. 
28. verus! {
29. 
30. // Ghost projection of any address to its abstract value (`int`).
31. pub uninterp spec fn spec_addr<T: Address>(addr: &T) -> int;
32. 
33. // `<PageAligned<T> as Address>::into_raw_value` is a method of the external
34. // `sys::mm::Address` trait. A trait-impl method cannot be body-verified in place
35. // without marking the whole `impl Address for PageAligned<T>` verified, which
36. // pulls every sibling method into scope and currently triggers a Verus
37. // front-end limitation (`vir/src/traits.rs` assertion). It is therefore specced
38. // here with `assume_specification`, mirroring the trust boundary the codebase
39. // already draws for `<PageAligned<T> as Address>::from_raw_value`
40. // (`kframe.spec.rs`) and `::arch::mem::PAGE_SIZE` (`frame.rs`). The bound is
41. // exactly `T: Address` (matching the external signature), and the `@`-based
42. // contract is expressible because `PageAligned<T>: View` now holds for every
43. // `T: Address`. The real proof obligation is the inner
44. // `<T as Address>::into_raw_value` newtype identity, discharged when the
45. // `Address` trait itself is verified.
46. //
47. // Pure newtype identity projection: the returned raw `usize` is exactly the
48. // abstract address. Callers' in-page offset math and page walking require an
49. // identity projection (no masking/shifting).
50. pub assume_specification<T: Address> [
51.     <PageAligned<T> as Address>::into_raw_value
52. ](addr: PageAligned<T>) -> (result: usize)
53.     ensures
54.         result as int == addr@,
55. ;
56. 
57. } // verus!
58.

1. # TCB Allowed List — Nanvix phys-mm
2. 
3. Any `external_body` outside this list must be removed.
4. 
5. ## Allowed `external_body`
6. 
7. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/mod.rs::book_physical_memory_regions` — iterates a std
8.   `alloc::collections::LinkedList` via `for region in list.iter()`. The build
9.   toolchain's `vstd` (`/mnt/toolchain/verus/vstd`) ships ghost-iterator specs only
10.   for `slice`/`vec`/`VecDeque`/`BTree*`/`Hash*` iterators, **not** `LinkedList`, and
11.   the orphan rule forbids supplying `View`/`ForLoopGhostIterator` impls for the
12.   foreign `linked_list::Iter` from the `kernel` crate (E0117). Genuine Verus
13.   front-end limitation, not a proof gap or code bug — full analysis in
14.   `verus-unsupported.md`. The abstract booking effect is specified over
15.   `PhysMemView` and discharged (no `admit`) by
16.   `lemma_book_region_reserves_region_frames` in `mod.proof.rs`. `ensures` keeps the
17.   caller-relevant guarantee: allocator stays initialized and well-formed.
18. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/mod.rs::book_mmio_regions` — same std-`LinkedList`
19.   iteration limitation as above. Abstract effect (skip-if-not-covered; book tracked
20.   frames) discharged by `lemma_book_mmio_skip_untracked` /
21.   `lemma_book_mmio_books_tracked`. `ensures` keeps allocator initialized and
22.   well-formed across booking.
23. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/kframe.rs::KernelFrame::deref`
24. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/kframe.rs::KernelFrame::deref_mut`
25. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/kframe.rs::KernelFrame::clear`- `src/libs/bump_allocator/src/lib.rs::FixedSizeBumpAllocator::alloc` — materializes a
26.   `&'static mut [u8; N]` from a backend-provided address (`usize as *mut`); raw-memory
27.   op Verus cannot verify without a `PointsTo` for the externally-owned `BssStorage`
28.   region. Mirrors `src/libs/raw-array`. `ensures` states alignment + in-bounds over
29.   the abstract `bump_view`.
30. - `src/libs/bump_allocator/src/lib.rs::FixedSizeBumpAllocator::alloc_as` — delegates to
31.   `alloc` and re-materializes the slot as `&'static mut MaybeUninit<T>`; same rationale.
32.   `ensures` adds the `size_of::<T>()`/`align_of::<T>()` vs `(N, A)` guard arms.
33. 
34. ## Skip / exclude from current proof target
35. 
36. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs::PhysMemoryManager::get_mut`
37. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/frame.rs::init`
38. 
39. ## Allowed `external_body` — frame allocator core (`frame.rs`)
40. 
41. `frame.rs` is now the proof target. Two layers form the trust boundary of the
42. global frame-allocator singleton; everything else in the module (the `frame::*`
43. free-function shims) is **body-verified** against these contracts.
44. 
45. ### 1. The singleton bridge: `instance()`
46. 
47. `instance()` returns `&'static mut Inner` obtained from the module-level
48. `static mut INSTANCE` via `unsafe { INSTANCE.assume_init_mut() }`. The verifier
49. does not support `static mut` paths, and a zero-argument uninterpreted
50. `phys_view()` cannot be tied to that static by any verifiable means. `instance()`
51. is therefore the bridge axiom: `requires phys_view().initialized` (the real panic
52. gate) and `ensures (*result).inv() && (*result)@ == phys_view().frames`. This is

   and `result.inv()`; on failure `spec_addr(&addr) % spec_page_size() != 0`; success
   holds iff the input address is page-aligned. Removed when `sys::mm::Address` /
   `Alignment` are verified.
 
 ## Allowed `assume_specification` — `hal::mem::PageAligned` `Address::into_raw_value`
 
 `<PageAligned<T> as Address>::into_raw_value` is a method of the external
 **`sys::mm::Address`** trait. A per-method `external_body`/`#[verus_spec]` would
 require marking the whole `impl Address for PageAligned<T>` verified, which currently
 triggers a Verus front-end panic (`vir/src/traits.rs:511 assertion failed:
 !method_impls.contains(&p)`) on this generic trait impl. It is therefore specced with
 `assume_specification` in `page.spec.rs`, mirroring the existing
 `<PageAligned<T> as Address>::from_raw_value` trust boundary (`kframe.spec.rs`) and the
 `::arch::mem::PAGE_SIZE` boundary (`frame.rs`). The `@`-based contract is expressible
 because `PageAligned<T>: View` now holds for every `T: Address` (unconditional `View`
 delegating to the ghost `spec_addr`). The real obligation is the inner
 `<T as Address>::into_raw_value` newtype identity, discharged when the `Address` trait
 is verified.
 
 - `<crate::hal::mem::PageAligned<T> as crate::hal::mem::Address>::into_raw_value`
   (declared in `src/kernel/src/hal/mem/types/address/aligned/page.spec.rs`).
   `ensures result as int == addr@`.
